what: Pre-registered before the first timed arm: the composed 512 aa fold delta of TT_BIO_DIT_COND_HOIST + TT_BIO_UNFUSED_SILU, both flags off on main, measured as one interleaved session on qb2 card 2 at a forced and during-sampled 1350 MHz.

basis.base_fold_note: campaign quiet-box median at a pinned, during-sampled 1350 MHz
basis.aa_floor_note: campaign quiet-box fold A/A floor; the session measures its own and the verdict is read against that one, not this

singles.silu_source: c12-unfused-silu-bh, each executed shape's own measured price x its own executed call count at 512 aa
singles.hoist_source: c12-cond-hoist-block-timing session 1, wall around the token-level DiffusionTransformer (session 2 read 0.2532 s; the branch's own comment carries 0.2415 s at 512 aa, so the single itself has a 0.213-0.253 s spread and the ceiling below uses the low end the row concluded on)

predicted.ceiling_note: pure additivity: no interaction, and every second of device time saved reaches the fold. This is a CEILING, not the prediction.
central_construction: 0.4977 s  sum of the two singles

-0.0125 s op-level double-count bound. The pass-18 disjointness audit: silu fires in Transition.swiglu fc1, cond-hoist deletes 9,600 DiT layer_norm calls and its own linear-class contribution is -0.0039 s, so the shared term is bounded at 0.0125 s.

-0.0649 s half the fold-average host-overlap haircut. Exposed host time F = 3.983 s of 14.881 s = 26.76 %; charging the full fraction would assume both regions overlap host work at the fold average, and both sit in device-bound regions (the diffusion sampler and the pair transitions), so half is the midpoint between no attenuation and fold-average attenuation. This term is a stated placeholder, not a measurement: it exists so that a measured 0.485 s reads as 'no attenuation' rather than as 'beat the prediction'.
predicted.how_much_less_than_additive: 0.0777 s less at the central, i.e. 15.6 % of the sum. At least 0.0125 s less, because that is the only interaction anything has measured; more than 0.0777 s less only if a region that measures as device time does not reach the fold.

kill_criteria.a: composed delta inside the session's OWN A/A floor is not a result, whatever its sign
kill_criteria.b: composed delta below the larger single (0.2843 s) means the two levers interact and the stack is NOT approvable as a stack
kill_criteria.c: any arm whose witness is absent (hoist_norms 0 on a hoist arm, silu_calls 0 on a silu arm, or either nonzero on base) is VOID; its timing may not be reasoned about
kill_criteria.d: any warm fold whose sampled AICLK minimum is below 1200 MHz makes the session an artifact, not a regression

go_criteria: composed delta >= 0.2843 s AND >= 3x the session's own A/A floor AND the stack's own accuracy inside the 0.60 A reject bar on cdk2x2_298 with the same-session seed floor quoted beside it and a 0.0000 A A/A control.

not_in_this_stack.TT_BIO_LINEAR_KBLOCK: left OFF deliberately. It concluded at ~0.035 s, below its own 0.10 s kill criterion, and _LINEAR_BLOCK is keyed on (mt_total, kt, nt) and not on operand placement, so with every `a` operand forced to L1 its two DRAM keys inverted to 0.9416x and 0.9545x. 7 % of the stack for that risk is not worth taking.

instrument.fold: perf/c12_compose/fold_compose.py --arms base,silu,hoist,both,base --reps 5, one process, one device open, one model load, cold rep over the full arm list discarded, _cond_weights() forced and walled before the first timed rep
instrument.accuracy: perf/c12_compose/acc_stack.py --size 298 --arms base,both --seeds 0,1, with the base-vs-base same-seed A/A control
instrument.clock: perf/c12_compose/clk.py, ARC message 0x33 through tt-kmd IOCTL 17, sampled at 500 Hz in a SUBPROCESS for the duration of every fold

nothing_flips: Release-gated, branch-only. Both flags stay env_flag(..., False). Only Moritz approves a default.
